help.text:
🍽️ FoodBot helps you track recipes and figure out what to cook.

➕ Add food — add a recipe to your personal list or the shared global list: name, prep time, category, ingredients (tap existing ones, type a few letters to search, or type a full new name to add it), optional amounts for each one (totally skippable), then an optional recipe. You'll get to review everything before saving.

🍳 What can I cook? — pick how much time you have, tell me what's in your kitchen and whether you can go shopping, then tap any suggestion to see exactly what you have and what you'd need to buy. Shopping suggestions are sorted so the ones needing the least extra shopping come first. If nothing in the list fits, you'll get a recipe suggestion pulled in for you or, if shopping's off-limits, a nudge toward a protein or carb you already have.

🔍 Search recipes — type a food name (or part of it, like "ghorme" for Ghormeh Sabzi) and the closest matches appear, or tap "👤 My list" to browse everything you've ever added, no typing needed. One result shows the recipe right away; multiple results show buttons to choose from. For foods on your personal list, you'll see a ⚙️ Settings button to edit or delete. Global foods can only be changed by the admin.

🌐 Language — switch between English and Persian anytime.

💬 Feedback — drop a message straight to the admin.

/cancel — cancel whatever you're in the middle of.

/help — show this message.
